info.name: QOwnNotes
info.summary: Edit your QOwnNotes notes on the web and sync them with QOwnNotes Desktop and Android
info.description:
QOwnNotes for Nextcloud lets you view and edit the notes of your [QOwnNotes](https://www.qownnotes.org) note folder in the Nextcloud web interface, including note subfolders and the tags stored in the note folder's `notes.sqlite`.
It also provides the server APIs for the [QOwnNotes desktop app](https://www.qownnotes.org) (note versions and trash) and the [QOwnNotes Android app](https://github.com/qownnotes/qownnotes-android) (a Nextcloud Notes API compatible note API), and replaces the QOwnNotesAPI app.
- **Plain files:** notes stay Markdown files in your Nextcloud, organized in note subfolders like in QOwnNotes Desktop - **Tags:** hierarchical tags with colors, shared with QOwnNotes Desktop and Android through the note folder's `notes.sqlite` - **Web interface:** note list, subfolder and tag trees, Markdown editor with preview, conflict handling, versions and deleted notes - **Integrations:** dashboard widget, unified search (also by tags), link previews and "Open in QOwnNotes" in Files - **API-only mode:** administrators can disable the web interface and only provide the APIs
Tags need the PHP extension `pdo_sqlite`. If you switch from the QOwnNotesAPI or Notes app, see the [migration guide](https://github.com/qownnotes/qownnotes-nextcloud/blob/main/docs/migration.md).
info.author: Patrizio Bekerle
